result.topic_en: Counting arrangements (cyclic sequences) of a and b elements by their exact period, using binomial coefficients (a+b)!/(a!b!) as Cauchy-type integrals and inclusion–exclusion over the divisors p, q.
result.transcription:
a rel. prim zu b
$\left(\frac{(a+b)[-...-]!}{a!\,b!}\right)\frac{1}{a+b}$ $\quad \frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi} x^{-n} f x\, d\varphi$ $\quad z = (re^{\varphi i})^{-\alpha}(1+re^{\varphi i})^{\alpha+\beta}$
$a = p\alpha \quad b = p\beta$ $\qquad (1+x)^{a+b} = \sum x^{a}\frac{(a+b)!}{a!\,b!}$ $\qquad 175$
$\left(\frac{(a+b)!}{a!\,b!} - \frac{(\alpha+\beta)!}{\alpha!\,\beta!}\right)\frac{1}{(a+b)} + \frac{(\alpha+\beta)!}{\alpha!\,\beta!}\frac{1}{(\alpha+\beta)}$
[-$\frac{p(\alpha+\beta)}{p}$-]
$\frac{(a+b-1)!}{a!\,b!} + \frac{(\alpha+\beta-1)!}{\alpha!\,\beta!}\left(1-\frac{1}{p}\right)$ $\qquad \frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi} x^{-a}(1+x)^{a+b}\, d\varphi$
$a = pq\alpha \quad b = pq\beta$
Die Periode $(\alpha+\beta)$ haben $\frac{(\alpha+\beta)!}{\alpha!\,\beta!} = \frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi} z\, d\varphi$
Die Periode $q(\alpha+\beta)$ haben $\frac{(q\alpha+q\beta)!}{q\alpha!\,q\beta!} - \frac{(\alpha+\beta)!}{\alpha!\,\beta!} = \frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}(z^{q} - z)\, d\varphi$
Die Periode $p(\alpha+\beta)$ haben $\frac{(p\alpha+p\beta)!}{p\alpha!\,p\beta!} - \frac{(\alpha+\beta)!}{\alpha!\,\beta!} = \frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}(z^{p} - z)\, d\varphi$
Die Per[?] $pq(\alpha+\beta)$ $\frac{(a+b)!}{a!\,b!}$
[-...-]$^{n}$ $pq$
$\frac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}(z^{pq} - z^{q} - z^{p} + z)\, d\varphi$
